notes: Account: boutique institutional research provider focused on sell-side analysis and client-facing research portal.
Primary ask: replace aging keyword search with semantic RAG pipeline using bi-encoder + cross-encoder reranker. Emphasis on embeddings quality + reranking precision for analyst workflows.
Scale: pilot ~10M research objects (PDFs, reports, datasets), full target ~50-75M docs over 12 months. Estimated embeddings store ~3.5-5 TB depending on vector dims.
Latency targets: cold-query 200-400ms acceptable, warm-path p95 <250ms for top-k retrieval + rerank; interactive analyst flows need <500ms end-to-end; batch scoring jobs overnight ok.
Cost sensitivity: looking for predictable unit economics; target query cost < $0.003/query (including retrieval + rerank) or reserved pricing equivalent.
Security: must keep EU customer data in EU, KMS-managed keys (customer-controlled), full audit trails, SSO (SAML) integration with Okta. Air-gap not required but private control plane desired.
Deployment preference: Dedicated capacity (reserved GPU pools) to guarantee throughput and EU residency. Private deployment (VPC) acceptable if control plane can remain in EU region.
Quote from CTO (11/20 call): 'If we can't keep keys and residency under our control, we simply won't move production search over.'

POC scope agreed (11/28): 10M doc ingest, two embedding models (dense 1536 and 1024 dim), reranking with cross-encoder candidate size 100 -> rank top 5; evaluation against curated prompt set (500 queries).
Success metrics: MRR improvement in analyst retrieval, precision@5 > baseline by 18%, cost/Q <= target, p95 latency under SLO on dedicated config.

Security review: initial questionnaire submitted (drive link). Legal asked for data processing addendum and key custody appendix. Security team flagged L3 for key custody — working w/ Redwood to confirm KMS flow.
Procurement: procurement draft sent 11/30. They want 12-month reserved capacity with break clause tied to performance. Procurement rate card needs to include dedicated commit + overage pricing.
Internal contacts: Head of Research - Claire Holloway; CTO - Martin Voss; Infra lead - Ana Moretti.
Conversation notes (11/15 discovery): analyst demo with current slow reranker; 'search feels like magic when it works, but wrong top-k is worse than no match' — emphasis on reranker precision.
Risk items: long tail of PDF parsing/metadata hygiene, doc deduplication, incremental indexing latency for live research updates.
Requested artifacts: benchmark template, model quantization/recommended RPMs, SLO language for p95/p99 latencies, EU KMS integration doc.
AE notes: Jordan to push pricing for 12m reserved / 6m trial; coordinate SE for benchmark script and sample dataset export.
Next meeting scheduled: 2025-12-05 technical kickoff (SE-led) — agenda: ingest pipeline, vector storage sizing, reranker infra, benchmark harness.
Follow-ups: obtain sample 1M doc export by 2025-12-03; SE to provision dev dedicated pool estimate for POC (target 2x expected QPS).
